numerical_scope: Three offline fixtures; board replays one real-image fixture 18 times per graph. Full outputs stable within each batch, not bitwise equivalent across graphs or to the simulator. Detection gate: threshold 0.25, same count/classes, IoU>=0.98 and score error<=0.02. No mAP validation.
limits: 12 ordinary wall-clock samples and 3 native timing samples per graph; not a sustained camera test
Static instruction requests are not measured DDR transactions or measured stall cycles
OCM policy matches; actual placement may change with the graph
Matching buffer addresses prove no intermediate copy, not on-chip retention
FP16 accumulation differences remain; no labelled validation set
transport_observations: Three normal shutdown requests closed SSH; each recovered to a distinct new boot; no SDK workload retry
reproduction: Retained setup.py/host.py/analyze.py/receipt.py and full source-build/board archives. Maintained analyzers: analyze_npu.py, analyze_pointwise.py, compare_simulation.py, check_view_aliases.py and trace_memory_flow.py.
